summary: A Next.js App Router app on Node with server components, validated Server Actions and browser tests against the production build.
description: Start a Next.js App Router project that builds for production and runs under next start on Node. Pages render on the server from a server-only service, forms post to Server Actions that validate with zod and show field errors, and a route handler serves JSON. Vitest covers schemas, services and client components; Playwright drives the production build in Chromium. There is no database, sign-in or hosting setup; add those for a real product.
seoDescription: A Next.js App Router starter on Node with server components, zod-validated Server Actions, ESLint, Vitest and Playwright against the production build.

projectExamples.title: Internal request tracker
projectExamples.description: Server-rendered lists and forms that post to Server Actions, starting from the in-memory items slice. Swap the service for a real database and add sign-in before sharing it.

projectExamples.title: Self-hosted product site
projectExamples.description: Server-rendered marketing and account pages served by next start on your own box, with a health route for the load balancer. Add a database and sign-in when the product needs them.

plain.whatItIs: A starter web app built with Next.js, which draws its pages on the server before sending them to the browser.
